cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Lost in the Process
cards.instruction: Hide your role in the problem by distributing blame across steps, policies, and unnamed procedures.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your parcel was lost between reception and dispatch. Use the incident format I taught you; put the failed stage in the first box.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You left it on the bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've identified transport. Write 'dispatch transferred without a receipt'. You used to skip the handover stage entirely.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Both departments are you. Call the bus company.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll call. You finish the report: dispatch, transport, receipt control. Three stages to investigate; don't squeeze them into one name after all that training.
